Seamless Static Analysis with Cppcheck: From IDE to CI and Code Review - Daniel Marjamäki - CppCon 2025
---

Static analysis should be part of your development workflow—not a separate step. With the right setup, you can get immediate results without switching tools.

In this talk, we’ll explore how Cppcheck, a powerful open-source static analysis tool, can be smoothly integrated into your entire development pipeline. You’ll learn how to:

- Use a unified Cppcheck configuration across your IDE and CI pipeline to get real-time feedback as you code that will always match the warnings you get in CI.

- Generate SARIF reports from Cppcheck and incorporate them into code review platforms for streamlined collaboration.

- Extend Cppcheck by integrating clang-tidy, enabling combined analysis in a single run—and discuss the benefits of doing so.
